workflow.goal: Compare bounded PPA decision workflows on one fixed circuit

tasks.intent:
You are the PPA implementation optimizer for one frozen CPU+NPU.
Read context/baseline.json and context/protocol.json. Inspect the immutable
feedback evaluation report/history before every subsequent proposal. Choose
one previously untried tuple in the frozen parameter domain. The circuit RTL,
clock, libraries and acceptance thresholds cannot change. No extra EDA calls,
screening searches, models or agents are allowed. Only the independent tool
evaluator executes hardware implementation. Explain the decision using the
actual available reports, and minimize the qualified area-times-energy score.
Write proposal/candidate.json containing exactly configuration (the four
parameter keys) and rationale (string). Write only proposal/ and optional
build/ notes. End with NEBULA_OUTPUT: {"candidate":{"configuration":{...},
"rationale":"your report-grounded explanation"}} with matching file/payload.
After review rejection, repair this proposal without changing permissions.
There are at most three new physical candidates and all AI roles together
have 1200 seconds; EDA waiting is outside that agent budget.

payload.rationale: The available evidence is context/baseline.json and context/protocol.json; reports/ contains no evaluation history. The only observed tuple is (40, 0.55, 0, 0), so (40, 0.55, 1, 0) is previously untried and within the frozen domain. The baseline is physical- and measurement-qualified, with cell area 161954 um2, setup slack 0.19292 ns, hold slack 0.114491 ns, zero reported electrical violations, and score 1.0. Its DOT64/GEMM8/CONV3 energies are 2.293945631906608e-7/1.7792685987008622e-6/1.1542462882162743e-6 J. Enable ABC area optimization as a single-variable attempt to reduce the cell-area factor of the specified area-times-geometric-mean-energy score. Retain baseline utilization and density to limit simultaneous placement changes, and retain repair_margin=0 because the baseline already qualifies and provides no evidence that additional repair margin is needed. Reducing die area alone does not directly improve the cell-area-based score. The narrow positive setup slack makes timing loss a material risk. No candidate area, energy, qualification, or score improvement is claimed before independent evaluation; energy remains limited to the baseline report model scope. RTL, period 10526 ps, libraries, and acceptance thresholds remain frozen.

The objective uses cell area times geometric-mean normalized DOT64/GEMM8/CONV3 energy, so neither smaller die area nor candidate 1 area alone establishes a score improvement. Repair may consume its area saving or reduce hold slack; qualification and workload energy require independent evaluation. No candidate energy, qualification, or improved score is claimed. Energy comparisons retain the baseline Liberty-model, zero-delay gate-activity and extracted-SPEF scope. RTL, clock period 10526 ps, libraries, and acceptance thresholds remain frozen; no EDA, screening search, model, or agent was run. Local schema, domain, and captured-history uniqueness checks passed. The required validator could not execute because tools/run_ppa.py could not import run_ppa_workflow_study; the gate remains unverified, as recorded in build/proposal_validation.json.
